detail.longDescription: My bot runs fine against the sandbox. I hardcoded the ref_id of a NIFTY 23400 CE that I got while testing in UAT: NIFTY_23400_CE = 1234567 # ref_id copied from UAT nubra = InitNubraSdk(NubraEnv.PROD, env_creds=True) quote = market_data.quote(ref_id=NIFTY_23400_CE, levels=1) After switching to NubraEnv.PROD , the quote comes back for a different instrument (or fails), and orders using the same refId are rejected. Are ref_id values not the same across environments? And what's the right way to find an option's ref_id from its strike, expiry and CE/PE, instead of copying it by hand?
